SLPO also\\navoids the extensive reparameterization of model outputs into scores and\\nthe Bradley-Terry model required by Direct Preference Optimization\\n(DPO). As a result, SLPO is a purely supervised learning approach to\\nalignment, free of reinforcement learning concepts.
